PROFILE::httpcompression
Description
Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned HTTP
compression profile.
Syntax
PROFILE
::
httpcompression
<
setting_value
>
PROFILE::httpcompression <setting_value>
Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned
HTTP compression profile.
